# Aquila and Priscilla’s Home (Romans 16:3)

## Emotional Focus
A husband and wife working and loving God together.

## Key KJV
“Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus.” (Romans 16:3)

## Gentle Retelling
Aquila and Priscilla worked side by side making tents and opened their home to teach others about Jesus. Their family was a safe place for friends.

## Coloring Prompt

## Read-Along Flow + Response
